narratives: Make safe the roof structure under the roof-mounted hot water system.
Storm / wind. The hot water system on the roof is not engineered for the load. Timber beams have dipped under the weight.

First attendance failed to make safe due to insufficient work-order communications. The work order referenced a patio. No staff were on site for clarity. Reattendance completed the timber and bugle work. Fitted two structural timber pieces with bugle screws from the base plate to the underpurlin, giving the roof extra support under the hot water system.
